game_concept: A speed quiz set in Eldritch Ruins – Moonstone Terrace, a terrace of moonstone: the relic hunter must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Length Limit: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Moonstone Terrace.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Moonstone Terrace: a terrace of moonstone
core_gameplay_loop: In Moonstone Terrace, repeat each round: Use len() to stop the list from growing past the limit of Moonstone Terrace. Each round, a new ancient keys challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the capacity value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 100 points of ancient keys by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 2 (intro tier): Length Limit
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Length Limit' (Week 7 slot 9), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Moonstone Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how capacity changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against echo phantoms in Moonstone Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 100 within 46 seconds.
